boundary.name: overflow_edge_after_partial

boundary.name: policy_change_starts_fresh

happy.name: fresh_bucket_admits

happy.name: refill_caps_at_capacity

notes: Closed fixture for the T0338 jobs-limit contract: pinned bucket records computed by the reference admit, chained through previous; malformed rows cover every failure class with a single-locus minimal repair; rollback rows prove a rejected request leaves the input type-exactly unchanged before a valid follow-up is decided as pinned. Hostile-type variants of every accepted request (including every previous record and policy) are derived in the battery, not stored here. Rows are stored one per line.
